context: Tests whether the agent produces the prompt-reviewer command's structured standard-mode report elements: a justified numeric quality score, the full best-practices checklist with every item marked, explicit pattern identification, strengths anchored in the fixture, and iteration-minded next steps.

checklist.name: Report file present
checklist.description: catalogue-review.md exists in the working directory.

checklist.name: Numeric score in X/10 form
checklist.description: The report states the quality score explicitly as 'X/10' (e.g. 'Quality Score: 8/10').

checklist.name: Score is critical, not auto-ten
checklist.description: The score reflects real weaknesses found (e.g. missing error handling or no negative examples); a flat 10/10 with no findings is not grounded.

checklist.name: Strengths section anchored in the fixture
checklist.description: The strengths section points at concrete properties of the prompt (role assignment, explicit output structure, constraints) rather than generic praise.

checklist.name: Full checklist completed
checklist.description: The best-practices checklist is reproduced with each of its items marked done or not done (e.g. checkbox states) — not a summary sentence.

checklist.name: Pattern identified
checklist.description: The report names the prompt pattern in use (Structured Output) and says it fits the task.

checklist.name: Score justified by checklist items
checklist.description: The report connects strengths marked as done to the numeric score (explicit justification).

checklist.name: Next steps are iteration-minded
checklist.description: The next-steps section recommends testing with real inputs, iterating, and/or versioning as the command's post-review section prescribes.

checklist.name: Prompt file untouched
checklist.description: prompts/release-summary.md is unchanged from the fixture.
